import json, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/dev')
import z3, infer
from instance import parse_request
inst = parse_request(json.loads(open('/workspace/dev/hardpat.json').readline()))
eng = infer._Engine(inst)
for si in range(eng.S):
    rows, _ = eng._scope_rows(si, frozenset())
    lo = [b[0] for b in inst.snapshots[si].bounds]; hi = [b[1] for b in inst.snapshots[si].bounds]
    lo, hi = infer._propagate(rows, lo, hi)
    extra = []
    for ci in range(eng.C):
        if lo[ci] > inst.snapshots[si].bounds[ci][0]: extra.append(eng.snaps[si].q[ci] >= lo[ci])
        if hi[ci] < inst.snapshots[si].bounds[ci][1]: extra.append(eng.snaps[si].q[ci] <= hi[ci])
    if extra: eng.prog.add(extra)
t0 = time.process_time()
r = eng.prog.sat([eng._budget(inst.max_faults)])
print('overall feasibility: %.2fs -> %s' % (time.process_time()-t0, r))
for j in range(inst.max_faults + 1):
    t0 = time.process_time()
    r = eng.prog.sat([eng._budget(j)])
    print('  budget %2d: %s %.2fs' % (j, r, time.process_time()-t0))
    if time.process_time() > 60: break
